# Incremental Reconciliation

The incremental reconciliation feature allows for the processing of merged pull requests and commits that happened after a specified watermark. It enables efficient updates to the knowledge artifacts without needing to perform a full compilation, thereby improving performance for ongoing development.

**Anchored to:**

- `knowledge_compiler/compiler/run.py` — `knowledge_compiler.compiler.run.reconcile`
